steps.title: Prepare Mouse for Catheterization
steps.instruction: Place the mouse under isoflurane anesthesia.

steps.title: Insert Micro-manometer Catheter
steps.instruction: Percutaneously introduce a 1.4 Fr. Millar catheter into the carotid artery and gently advance it into the left ventricular cavity.
